what: Qwen-Image 2.1 Q4_K_M on an M5 Max, one fresh process per cell, through api.sample under the bounded cache. state_bytes is one conditioning's built state; prefill_gib the footprint of one prefill over the footprint before it, state included; steps_gib the footprint of each step over the settled process, states included. routes lists the kernel routes in force. rows, where present, is the rows a step evaluates together: 1 for a guided request planned one row at a time.
